message:
GCC has ASAN available. The test failed because there's no main function, but the ASAN runtime itself is there. Let me use GCC with ASAN instead of clang. Let me build with GCC:

<｜｜DSML｜｜=execute_bash>
<｜｜DSML｜｜=command>cd /workspace && bash build.sh 'cd /gt/_work/src && export CC=gcc CXX=g++ && export CFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && export CXXFLAGS="-fsanitize=address -g -O1 -fno-omit-frame-pointer" && ./autogen.sh --disable-shared --without-debug --without-http --without-python --without-zlib --without-lzma 2>&1 | tail -20'</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
